messages:
zoe: Quick pitch 1: run a 6-week remediation sprint pilot. Owners assigned within 48h, weekly 20m sync, async tracker updates. Keep P0s on an expedited path.

ricky: +1. Require a fallback owner and a closure reviewer on every action. Can we get auto-reminders for ETAs?

ops-bot: Reminder job created. Will DM owners 72h before action ETAs and post to #eng-oncall if overdue >48h. Use `/remind-config` to tweak windows.

zoe: IC rotation idea: 4-week rotation with a 3-day overlap for handoff/shadowing. Keeps context moving.

ricky: Add a 45-day closure window: items older than that escalate to Eng Manager + PM or move to the pattern backlog with rationale.

zoe: I'll create a remediation sprintboard (pilot) and post the link here by EOD. Planning a 15m retro after week 2 to adjust cadence.
